title: PlanRecovery
description: Golden bundle for plan recoveries. The wire payloads are its two members, not this object: `ward_pulse_exhausted_windows_result_json` answers with an array of `windowKey`, `ward_pulse_plan_recoveries_result_json` with an array of `planRecovery`. The keys are also what the phone persists between polls.

exhausted.description: Windows reported spent by the snapshot the phone last saw.

recoveries.description: Windows that were in `exhausted` and now report room again.

allowanceId.description: Unique inside its account, not across accounts, which is why the pair is the key.

accountId.description: Keys the notification so a repeat replaces it. Never shown to the reader.

provider.description: Which family the window belongs to: two subscriptions can both call a window "Weekly plan".

resetsAt.description: When the window is next expected to roll. Null when the provider does not say: the recovery is still real, but no wake can be scheduled for it.
